title: arifOS Unified Response Envelope v2
description: v2.0.0 — Canonical verdict ontology: canonical_verdict, authority_scope, receipt_state, execution_state are separate axes. Every tool response uses this envelope. DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this envelope schema

capability_id.description: Transport-neutral capability ID from capability_registry.json, e.g. 'reality.observe'

implementation_tool.description: MCP tool name that implemented this capability, e.g. 'arif_observe'

status.description: Execution status of the tool call. Does NOT carry governance meaning.

canonical_verdict.description: DOMINANT action verdict. Single top-level decision that overrides all diagnostics below. PROCEED = action allowed. HOLD = insufficient authority/evidence, refer to sovereign. DENY = explicitly refused. VOID = action cannot be evaluated.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason code for the canonical_verdict, e.g. 'ACTOR_UNVERIFIED', 'REGISTRY_DRIFT', 'AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT'

authority_scope.description: What the caller is permitted to do. OBSERVE_ONLY = read-only. LIMITED_MUTATE = reversible changes only. FULL = all permitted actions.

receipt_state.description: Whether a VAULT999 seal entry exists for this action.

execution_state.description: Lifecycle state of the requested action.

can_continue_observing.description: Whether the caller may continue observe-class actions regardless of canonical_verdict.

can_mutate.description: Whether the caller may perform mutation-class actions.

can_claim_success.description: Whether the caller may treat the action as successfully completed.

evidence_refs.description: References to source evidence or VAULT999 receipts.

recommended_next.description: Recommended next actions for the caller.

governance.description: Additional governance signals (advisory, may be empty on OBSERVE calls).

floors_checked.description: F1–F13 floors that were verified, e.g. ['F1:PASS', 'F2:PASS']

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for PROCEED.

canonical_id.description: Normalized canonical actor identity (ARIF, FORGE, AUDITOR, etc.)

verified.description: Whether the actor's identity was cryptographically verified.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical result fields for audit integrity.
